title: CommCP: Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination via LLM-Based Communication with Conformal Prediction
scope_note: RGB-D observations feed model-directed exploration preferences and peer communication; an internally constructed semantic map guides a fixed frontier/TSDF navigation executor. Fixed conformal calibration is not a separate agent decision. Simulator localization and map bounds remain implementation assumptions.

title: Scale-Plan: Scalable Language-Enabled Task Planning for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Teams
scope_note: O3/A2: the paper selects task-relevant actions/objects and directly produces coordinated plans; Fast Downward belongs to baselines. O3/A3: the current official implementation separately generates and repairs task functions and thread synchronization. Reported evaluation uses GoTo teleport mode; navigation mode is a distinct demonstration configuration.

title: lampOS: The open-source operating system for physical AI
scope_note: Model-directed robot API selection and composition. O1/A2 receives camera images directly; O2/A2 receives supplied visual descriptions through the text-only model route. Fixed event reactions and low-level tracking are execution components. Skill creation alone does not establish retained feedback-directed self-improvement.

title: ResearchBoost-Agent: An autonomous agent that profiles, optimizes, and validates AI training code
scope_note: Robot-domain configurations: agent-directed profiling and optimization of Motus and FastWAM training workflows, with accepted revisions retained inside reusable implementation components; RoboTwin evaluation optimization is a further tool-code case. Frozen judges validate numerical consistency and efficiency. Reported speedups do not establish improved robot task competence or successor-model research.
